headline: OpenAI launches a safer ChatGPT for teens — years after teens started using it
snapshot: ChatGPT for Teens adds age-appropriate safety measures, parental controls, and learning tools designed to steer teens away from harmful content — and from using AI to cheat on their homework. The story matters because AI is moving deeper into legal and regulatory territory, where product speed, data rights, safety obligations and public accountability can affect adoption.
